d:
A story of love that refuses to fade, no matter how far destiny pulls two hearts apart.
• Teri Umeed* is a soulful romantic recreation that follows the emotional journey of a young woman searching for the man she once loved. While the world now knows him as a feared gangster, she still believes in the person he used to be. Holding on to memories, hope, and an unbreakable bond, she continues her search, believing that true love can find its way back despite the darkness that stands between them.
Composer – Javed-Mohsin
Lyricist- Rashmi Virag
Singer- Neeti Mohan & Yasser Desai
